overview: 1857, 19th-century reform movements and the Freedom Movement with an Andhra/Hyderabad focus: 43 official questions (2008-2024), every year. National freedom movement leads (19), then Andhra freedom movement (9) and reform movements (8). 33 are one-liners (founder, date, place, epithet); since 2019 APPSC adds 'which events fall in phase/tenure X' multi-selects, INC-session matching and chronology.

possibility.evidence: 0 official Qs; several related APPSC items (Meerut 10 May, Enfield rifle, Canning)
possibility.what_they_ask: natural targets: date and place of outbreak, immediate cause (greased cartridges), leader-centre pairs, GG at the time, interpretations (Savarkar, Syed Ahmad Khan)
fate of Bahadur Shah Zafar; natural targets: Act of 1858, Queen's Proclamation
who attacked the Hyderabad Residency (Turrebaz Khan); order of Hyderabad events 1839-1858

possibility.angle: Religious and social reform movements - India
possibility.what_they_ask: founder of each society and its year/place (Brahmo, Tattvabodhini, Theosophical, Arya Samaj Shuddhi); reformer's paper; caste vs other movements
journal-founder (Viveka Vardhini - Veeresalingam); natural targets: widow remarriage 1881, Gidugu's spoken-Telugu movement
Moderates vs Extremists; exact dates (Direct Action Day, Independence Bill); INC presidents-sessions; Lucknow Pact; NCM institutions; events in a Viceroy's tenure

possibility.angle: Freedom movement in Andhra and Hyderabad
possibility.what_they_ask: Sri Bagh Pact parties; Rampa years and Alluri sites; Kurnool Circular; Tenali bomb case; epithets (Andhra Shivaji); Hyderabad State Congress; Telangana struggle trigger
author of 'Why I am an Atheist'; founders of HRA 1924
newspaper-person matching (Indian Sociologist, Talwar, Islamic Fraternity, Swadesh Sevak)

traps.spot: Sri Bagh Pact with Telangana or Hyderabad in options
traps.fix: Sri Bagh 1937 = Coastal Andhra + Rayalaseema only; Gentlemen's Agreement 1956 = Andhra + Telangana

traps.trap: Paper or act given to a neighbouring Bengal reformer
traps.spot: Statement on Vidyasagar mentioning Sambad Kaumudi
traps.fix: Sambad Kaumudi (1821) = Rammohun Roy; Vidyasagar = Widow Remarriage Act 1856

traps.trap: Old institution passed off as a movement-born one
traps.spot: 'Which were not established during NCM' with AMU or a pre-1920 college
traps.fix: NCM national institutions: Jamia Millia 1920, Kashi Vidyapith 1921; Besant College 1915 and AMU (from MAO 1875) are not

traps.trap: Movement type mixed in a list
traps.spot: 'Which are caste movements' with Ghadar or Bijolia
traps.fix: Ghadar = revolutionary; Bijolia = peasant; Satyashodhak and Self-Respect = caste

traps.spot: Founder lists of HRA including Bhagat Singh
traps.fix: HRA 1924 Kanpur: Sanyal, J.C. Chatterjee, Bismil (Azad early); Bhagat Singh came with HSRA 1928

traps.trap: Ally given by date the wrong Mysore ruler
traps.fix: Her 1780 recovery used Hyder Ali's help; Tipu ruled only from 1782
traps.pyq: 'formed an alliance with Tipu Sultan' → false [group1-prelims-2023-paper2#110]

traps.spot: Four Guntur-region leaders with one title asked
traps.fix: Andhra Shivaji = Veerayya Chowdary; Andhra Ratna = Duggirala; Desabhakta = Konda Venkatappayya
Independence Bill introduced 4 July 1947; Direct Action Day 16 August 1946

techniques.name: Tenure window test
techniques.how: [Viceroy/phase → years] Convert the tenure or phase into years, then date each event; keep all inside the window.
techniques.example: Irwin 1926-31: Simon 1928, Lahore 1929, Dandi 1930 all inside → 'I, II and III' [group1-prelims-2024-paper1#28]; extremist phase 1905-18 includes Lucknow Pact and Home Rule [group1-prelims-2024-paper1#27]

techniques.name: INC session year ladder
techniques.how: Learn the early sessions year by year (1885 Bombay, 1886 Calcutta, 1887 Madras, 1888 Allahabad, 1889 Bombay) with presidents.
techniques.example: Naoroji-Calcutta 1886, Tyabji-Madras 1887, Yule-Allahabad 1888, Wedderburn-Bombay 1889 → 'IV I III II' [group1-prelims-2023-paper1#24]

techniques.name: Movement phase tagging for Andhra events
techniques.how: Tag every Andhra event with its national phase: Swadeshi 1905-11, NCM 1920-22, CDM 1930-34, Quit India 1942.
techniques.example: Tenali bomb case → Swadeshi/Vandemataram phase [group1-prelims-2010-reexam#98]; Kurnool Circular → Quit India [group1-prelims-2010#15]

techniques.name: Organisation sequence in Hyderabad
techniques.how: Fix the order Andhra Jana Sangham 1921 → Andhra Mahasabha 1930 → State Congress 1938; dates and founders follow from the sequence.

techniques.name: Place-city pinning for exiles and newspapers
techniques.how: Attach each revolutionary paper to its city and each exile to a place; matching becomes a lookup.
techniques.example: Indian Sociologist (London) - Shyamji; Islamic Fraternity (Tokyo) - Barkatullah; Talwar (Berlin) - Chattopadhyaya → 'II III I IV' [group1-prelims-2023-paper1#26]

techniques.name: Cause behind the event
techniques.how: For 'why' one-liners, recall the trigger story, not the general background; general grievances are distractors.
techniques.example: Doddi Komaraiah was killed defending Chakali Ailamma's land, not for general anti-vetti protest [group1-prelims-2019-paper1#26]

anchors: 10 May 1857 Meerut; Bahadur Shah Zafar exiled to Rangoon (d.1862); 17 July 1857 Hyderabad Residency attack
1828 Brahma Sabha; 1839 Tattvabodhini; 1856 Widow Remarriage Act; 1875 Arya Samaj and Theosophical Society (New York)
INC: 1886 Calcutta Naoroji; 1887 Madras Tyabji; 1888 Allahabad Yule; 1889 Bombay Wedderburn
1905 partition, 1911 annulled; 1907 Surat split; 1916 Lucknow Pact and Home Rule
1937 Sri Bagh Pact; 1938 Hyderabad State Congress; 1942 Kurnool Circular
4 July 1946 Doddi Komaraiah killed; 16 August 1946 Direct Action Day
checklist: Turn every phase or tenure into a year window first.
Andhra event? Tag it with the national movement of its year.
Founder questions: separate founder, later leader and first member.
Dates one day apart: recall the exact anchor, do not guess the middle.
In 'which were not' multi-selects, mark the stem negative before testing items.
Skip building rules on questions whose key is disputed (Brahma Sabha year, Belgaum session year).
